day_shape: 66 items: G7 and UNSC statements condemning Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia with UK announcing extra military support, US Treasury secondary-sanctions deadline Wednesday shutters Iranian air links (Turkish Airlines suspended until March 2027), CENTCOM reports 110 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, heavy Khamenei mourning cycle for Grand Ayatollah Shabiri, IDF strikes in Gaza after roadside bomb.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia draw Western response
threads.summary: The G7 and EU condemned continued Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and Bab al-Mandab shipping, the UN Security Council issued a press statement, and the UK MoD announced additional defensive military support to Riyadh. Sirens sounded on the Saudi-Yemen border and the G7 also called on Iran to stop arming the Houthis.

threads.label: US squeeze on Iranian air links
threads.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said foreign companies servicing Iranian airlines face secondary sanctions from Wednesday, and Turkish Airlines told Iran International it has suspended all Iran flights until at least March 2027, with Iraq following suit. China's foreign ministry called the airline sanctions illegal, according to IRIB.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade, tanker attacks and IRGC threats
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 110 commercial vessels enforcing the Iran blockade, while IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohibi told Fars the Guards were ready to change the "weaponry and geography of the war" if US strikes resume. Iran International reported two tankers hit in the Strait of Hormuz and Qatari mediation seeking a short-term deal.

threads.label: Khamenei mourning cycle for Ayatollah Shabiri
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a sequence of messages marking the death of Grand Ayatollah Seyyed Musa Shabiri Zanjani, calling him a first-tier Shiite researcher whose absence "has created a gap." IRIB and Defa Press amplified the condolence message and related biographical material.

threads.label: Gaza: roadside bomb and IDF response
threads.summary: The IDF said an unmanned engineering vehicle was struck by an explosive device along the Yellow Line in northern Gaza and that it responded with strikes on Hamas infrastructure, calling the incident a ceasefire violation. Defence Minister Israel Katz threatened to destroy what remains of Gaza City and displace around one million Gazans if Hamas takes an Israeli hostage.

threads.label: UN Human Rights Council on Iran
threads.summary: The UK delivered a national statement at the UNHRC 63 Interactive Dialogue on Iran, and Iran International reported the UN fact-finding mission told the Council that Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity in suppressing January protests and that two US February strikes on civilian sites amounted to war crimes. Both interventions were delivered in Geneva.

threads.label: Sacred Defence anniversary messaging
threads.summary: Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf and Expediency Council head Larijani gave keynote speeches at Sacred Defence commemorations, framing the recent war with the US and Israel as a repeat of Baathist "miscalculation," per IRIB and Defa Press. Defa Press also claimed Iran has entered the "club of mass production of hypersonic missiles" with the Fatah system.

events.title_en: Iran's membership in the club of mass production of hypersonic missiles
events.summary_en: Iran's membership in the club of mass production of hypersonic missiles. Iran, relying on domestic capabilities, smart design and asymmetric warfare strategy, has not only joined the exclusive club of hypersonic missile powers, but in certain metrics including operationalisation and mass production, has surpassed the United States. Iran's first official unveiling of the 'Fatah' hypersonic missile took place in June 2023, when Tehran officially announced it had achieved hypersonic missile technology as the fifth country in the world. The Fatah 1, designed with a manoeuvrable warhead and control fins, has the ability to manoeuvre at high speeds, and this very characteristic makes it difficult for air defence systems to intercept it.

events.title_en: Iran war causes Republican Senate candidates to distance themselves from Trump. Reuters news agency
events.summary_en: Iran war causes Republican Senate candidates to distance themselves from Trump. Reuters news agency: Republican Senate candidates Mike Rogers from Michigan and Ashley Hinson from Iowa, who are each in close competition with their rivals, called on Monday for a quick end to the Iran war. This positioning comes as they had previously supported Trump's authority to attack Tehran and are now trying to distance themselves from Donald Trump due to the severe increase in fuel prices, particularly record-breaking diesel prices.

events.summary_en: Two senior commanders of the Chinese army were dismissed. China's president dismissed two senior military commanders of the country's army due to 'serious breach of discipline and law' from the Communist Party of the country. The English newspaper Daily Telegraph reported that the dismissal of 'Zhang Youxia' and 'Liu Zhenli' from the Communist Party of China took place following allegations including infidelity, corruption, negligence in performing duties and other serious disciplinary violations. Zhang Youxia, according to reports, allegedly provided classified information about China's nuclear weapons to the United States and was previously widely recognised as Xi Jinping's closest military ally. events.title_en: The loss of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri has created a gap among first-tier Shiite researchers
events.summary_en: The loss of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri has created a gap among first-tier Shiite researchers. Undoubtedly, the absence of this distinguished personality has created a gap among the ranks of first-tier Shiite researchers in the present age, the remedy of which may take a long time. I express condolences for this tragedy to our Master, may God hasten his return, the seminaries, and particularly the students, devotees and especially the esteemed household of this scholar and advocate of virtue, and I beseech God Almighty for the elevation of the ranks of this great man. From an excerpt of the Supreme Leader's message following the demise of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri, 31 Shahrivar 1405.

events.title_en: The presence of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri was a place of teaching and learning, and his conduct towards students and scholars was humble and paternal
events.summary_en: The presence of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri was a place of teaching and learning, and his conduct towards students and scholars was humble and paternal. By God's grace, for more than three decades now, many have had the privilege of benefiting from his presence to the extent of their capacity and to draw provisions for their scholarly gatherings and teaching. His presence was a place of teaching and learning, even when those attending would walk towards his home after the lesson. Apart from his established scholarly merit, his humble and paternal conduct towards students and scholars was also something observable and instructive. From an excerpt of the Supreme Leader's message following the demise of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri, 31 Shahrivar 1405.

events.title: The IDF confirms carrying out strikes against Hamas infrastructure sites in the Gaza Strip this evening in response to a bomb that struck an engineering chenille earlier today. During routine operations on the Israeli side of the "Yellow Line" in northern Gaza, an unmanned engineering vehicle was hit by a roadside bomb, the army says. No injuries were caused in the incident, which the IDF says is a "blatant violation of the ceasefire agreement by the Hamas terror group." In response, several Hamas sites used by the terror group to advance attacks on troops and Israeli civilians were struck this evening, the military says.

events.title_en: Frame of Life: Narratives from the life of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution. The late Leader's approval of his son's discipleship under Ayatollah Shabiri. Ayatollah Seyed Jafar Shabiri Zanjani, brother of the late Ayatollah Seyed Musa Shabiri Zanjani, recounts: When we were having lunch with the late Master and Aqaseyyed Musa was also there, and their children were also at the table. The Master said to his brother: My sons became seminarians by their own choice and I did not tell them to become seminarians; of course I was pleased with their choice. When one of them came to Qom, I did not say come take lessons with you; he chose your lessons himself and I was also pleased with this choice.
